notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just a few tiny things in this update:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to advance text by scrolling down.
[*] Slightly sped up the blink animation.
[*] Fixes to the Russian translation.
[/list]
As always, thank you for your support!

If interested, check out the game I'm currently working on:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390800/Artificial_Selection_Demo/

notes.title: Giveaway & Czech Translation!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since the last one, but Locke(d) was generously provided a new translation: Big thanks to [b]Mikko[/b] for making the game available in [b]Czech[/b]!

We also hit a whopping [b]900+ reviews[/b]! As thanks for reaching this big milestone, I'm hosting (pun not intended) a [b]Host Keychain Giveaway[/b] in my [url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S]Discord server[/url]!

[h1][b]>> [url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S]Join us to enter! [/url]<<[/b][/h1]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/b50bf87c08873c93f6472ab9f3839fcc5496fd24.png[/img][/url]


And while you're already here, I'm happy to announce that a new game of mine is coming to Steam — [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924880/Artificial_Fashionista

Check it out if you like cute girls, dress-up games, or dressing up cute girls!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New Language & Merch!
notes.content:
I have big news!!!

The [b]Host keychain[/b] arrived today, and I'm so happy with how it looks:

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/b50bf87c08873c93f6472ab9f3839fcc5496fd24.png[/img][/url]

I can't believe I'm finally holding her in my hands. And soon, you might too! I'll be ordering the final batch, so preorders are open until [b]July 2nd[/b]!

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/44bbe4029e6286fdbebf078ea42931770785a172.png[/img][/url]
[i]After the preorder ends, quantities will be limited, so make sure not to miss out![/i]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/403be02dcdb98aacc697ee6bc3d7bfb3c91a947e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]But it doesn't end there![/h2] 
The game has also received a magnificent [b]French translation[/b], bringing us to a whopping [b]12 languages[/b] in total. A huge [b]thank you[/b] to all the volunteers who allowed Locke(d) to be played by so many people!

On top of that, the game engine was updated to the latest version, which makes Locke(d) playable on newer Macs, along with many other improvements.

Last but not least, a bug that prevented you from clicking on items in the room has been fixed. Sorry about that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/fdf885ac92d5ceb53eb9e9f00df3a4b34fb7e890.png[/img]

In the meantime, we've already hit another milestone with [b]600+ reviews[/b], and managed to maintain the [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] rating. I seriously appreciate all the love you've shown (and continue to show) to Locke(d). 

Thank you so much!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/5d99c9f2ca95e9cded14b9037154c1a78353e33c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

notes.title: Host Keychain!
notes.content:
It's almost been 4 months since Locke(d)'s release on Steam, and I still can't thank you enough for all the positive responses!

Quite a few of you have been requesting a way to save the Host from [spoiler]the game[/spoiler], which is why I'm happy to announce you will soon be able to carry her around with you in [b]physical form[/b]:

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/1f4a881a3868a502ec8c59190822368c84495286.png[/img][/url]

[h3]That's right — an [b]official Locke(d) Keychain[/b] is coming out! [/h3]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/44bbe4029e6286fdbebf078ea42931770785a172.png[/img][/url]

The first sample is currently on its way to me, and I can't wait to show you photos of the finished product! Until then, [b]preorders are already open[/b]!

[i]I can't guarantee if I'll ever order a second batch, so make sure to [b]preorder and don't miss out[/b] on this potential one-time chance.[/i]

Thank you so much for your support, and I look forward to sharing more news with you soon!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/5d99c9f2ca95e9cded14b9037154c1a78353e33c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Russian translation!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First of all, I wanted to thank you all for the overwhelming support so far. 

I never expected Locke(d) to be found and enjoyed by so many people. Ironically, the game really was picked up by some kind of algorithm that promoted the game way more than I could've anticipated. The chain of causality works in mysterious ways...

I appreciate all the thoughts you've shared in your reviews (I read every single one!), and encourage you to join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S]Discord server[/url] if you want to continue the discussion. We'd love to see you there!

Also, check out the game I'm working on right now. There's a big demo update coming out next week that will allow you to play the first 2 hours for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

With that out of the way, this update brings:
[list]
[*] Russian Translation
[*] Changed the menu font for Turkish and Russian
[*] The [SECRET] can now be activated multiple times
[*] Switched the position of the "Mute" button
[/list]

Thank you!
